precondition: The authoritative final actor result v2 and every result/model/table it binds must already be committed and complete. Its selection_mode is exactly no_challenge, component_final, or composition_final; the helper rederives winner_actor and every actor asset hash.
preparation: Run tools/flagged_ply_execution.py prepare-execution against the current HEAD commit/tree. The helper mechanically derives both actors and every hash; this template is not a launch input.
launch: Commit only the newly generated canonical execution file as the sole change in one direct-parent commit, then push once to agent/correctness-and-policy-upgrade.
